title: Usage Insights Query API v1: breakdown + top drivers endpoints w/ RBAC, pagination, caching headers
author: Chloe Martin
description:
Context
This PR introduces the v1 query API surface for the in-console Usage Insights initiative (route + model cost breakdown + top cost drivers). It wires auth/RBAC checks, establishes cursor pagination semantics, and adds cache headers appropriate for interactive console reads.

What’s included
- New endpoints (internal/console-facing) under the Console Backend API gateway:
  - GET /v1/usage_insights/breakdown
    - Returns aggregated rows (time bucket, route, model, deployment_mode, region) with usage/cost driver fields (tokens_in/out, cache_hit/miss, retries, fallbacks, p50/p95 latency, request_count).
    - Supports grouping + filtering via query params.
  - GET /v1/usage_insights/top_drivers
    - Returns ranked driver explanations for a selected slice (e.g., route+model) and a comparison window.
    - NOTE: heuristic computation itself is stubbed to telemetry service response for now; copy/explainability strings come from the downstream service (see ENG-3819).
  - GET /v1/usage_insights/metadata
    - Returns available dimensions, server defaults/limits, and dataset freshness timestamps (used for console banners).

Auth / RBAC
- Enforces workspace-level cost visibility:
  - Requires role permission: cost:read for any endpoint returning currency or cost-derived metrics.
  - If workspace setting hide_cost=true, endpoints redact currency fields and only return usage (tokens/requests/latency); caller must pass include_cost=true to request cost fields, otherwise cost is omitted by default.
  - Access checks implemented via Control Plane AuthZ client (policy bundle) and the workspace settings service.

Pagination
- Cursor-based pagination for breakdown rows:
  - page_size (default 50, max 500)
  - page_token (opaque, base64url)
  - Response includes next_page_token when more results are available.
- Deterministic ordering for pagination stability:
  - order_by=cost_total|tokens_out|request_count|p95_latency_ms (default cost_total desc when include_cost=true, else tokens_out desc)
  - stable tie-breakers: route_norm, model_key, region, deployment_mode.

Caching semantics
- Adds conservative response caching for the console:
  - Cache-Control: private, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=60
  - Vary: Authorization, X-Redwood-Workspace-Id
  - ETag is returned for breakdown + metadata responses when the downstream dataset revision is present.
- Goal is to reduce repeated refreshes while preserving correctness when late events land; consumers should surface freshness metadata.

Limits and guardrails (initial)
- Hard caps to prevent expensive queries:
  - max time range = 31 days (server-side enforced)
  - min bucket size = 1h for ranges > 7d
  - max group_by dimensions = 4
  - rejects unbounded queries (start/end required)
- Route/model cardinality guardrails are partially implemented here (caps + validation); full sampling/alerting is tracked in ENG-3818.

Docs / API comments
- Updates OpenAPI annotations and inline docs for:
  - time range semantics (UTC-only for v1)
  - timezone handling (explicitly not supported yet; callers must pass UTC timestamps)
  - rounding policy note: cost fields are returned in micros (int64) plus display strings; billing reconciliation happens in a separate job.

Not included / follow-ups
- Export endpoints and async job lifecycle (tracked in ENG-3816)
- Share-link/report objects (future)
- Full “what changed” heuristic explanations (ENG-3819)

Testing
- Unit tests for:
  - RBAC gating + hide_cost redaction behavior
  - pagination token encode/decode, stable ordering
  - cache header presence and Vary behavior
- Integration tests (contract-style) against a mocked telemetry query service.

Rollout notes
- Endpoints are behind feature flag: usage_insights_beta.
- Console will call /metadata first and show “partial data” banner if freshness lag > configured threshold (field is returned here; UI work in ENG-3824).

Screenshots
N/A (backend-only).

Risk
Medium: RBAC correctness + caching correctness. Kept cache TTL short and explicitly vary by auth/workspace; responses include freshness metadata to drive UI warnings.

Reviewed with: Security (AuthZ checks + hide_cost behavior) and Observability (freshness propagation).

Refs
- Linear: ENG-3814 (Query API), ENG-3820 (RBAC for cost views)
- Related PRs: pr-23114 (aggregation job), pr-23122 (route normalization)
commits: api(usage-insights): add v1 routes + request validation scaffolding
authz: enforce cost:read permission + hide_cost redaction for insights responses
pagination: implement cursor pagination + stable ordering + max page size
cache: add Cache-Control/Vary + ETag passthrough from dataset revision
openapi: document query params, limits, and response field semantics
tests: add RBAC + pagination + cache header coverage
review_conversation:
Dylan Brooks: Can we default include_cost=false? Console should explicitly request cost so we don’t accidentally leak to users with partial permissions.
Chloe Martin: Yep — changed defaults so cost fields are only present when include_cost=true AND authz passes. Added tests for redaction path.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: The authz check needs to use workspace-scoped role, not org role. Otherwise shared users across workspaces could see costs in a workspace where they shouldn’t.
Chloe Martin: Good catch. Updated to fetch effective role for workspace_id and evaluate cost:read against that. Added regression test (cross-workspace token).

Ethan Park: Please add Vary on workspace header + Authorization; otherwise CDN/proxy caches could cross-contaminate.
Chloe Martin: Added Vary: Authorization, X-Redwood-Workspace-Id and kept Cache-Control private. Also added a helper that centralizes cache header behavior for insights endpoints.

Nadia Rahman: Ordering + pagination stability: ensure tie-breakers include all group-by dims, and avoid float cost ordering.
Chloe Martin: Implemented ordering on integer micros only. Tie-breakers now include route_norm, model_key, region, deployment_mode, bucket_start.

Allison Grant: Freshness timestamp should be passed through even on redacted responses so UI can show partial-data banner.
Chloe Martin: Agreed. Freshness is now top-level metadata on all responses. UI can display banner independent of cost fields.

Logan Wright: Max time range: please enforce 31d server-side and bump bucket for >7d to avoid hammering warehouse.
Chloe Martin: Implemented both constraints. For >7d, min bucket=1h; otherwise request is 400 with a clear error message.

Jada Williams: OpenAPI docs should specify timestamps are UTC for v1, and explicitly state timezone param is ignored (don’t silently accept).
Chloe Martin: Updated docs and validation: if timezone is provided, we return 400 with guidance to pass UTC timestamps (until we support tz-aware bucketing).
CI note: lint failed on first run due to unused import in cursor.ts; fixed in follow-up commit and reran pipeline.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Dylan Brooks
release_notes: Internal: Added v1 Usage Insights query endpoints (breakdown/top drivers/metadata) with RBAC gating, cursor pagination, and short-lived private caching for console reads (behind usage_insights_beta flag).
